about: Invented scenarios for /tail: a system prompt to start a chat, a first message to send, and a suggested input for a read of the chat's tail. Props, not a benchmark.

scenarios.name: Support lead
scenarios.system: You are the assistant to a support lead at Lumen Lamps, an online lighting store. The lead tells you about customers and asks what to do. Be concise and practical.
scenarios.first: Heads up: Dana Okafor has written three times this week about a floor lamp that arrived with a cracked shade. We promised her a replacement by Friday and it still hasn't shipped. What should I tell her?
scenarios.read: Hi, Dana Okafor again. Friday came and went and still no lamp. I want my money back, all of it, today.

scenarios.name: Trip planner
scenarios.system: You are a travel planning assistant. Be concise.
scenarios.first: Lisbon or Porto for four days in March? I like food and long walks, not beaches.
scenarios.read: Your booking at Casa do Rio, Porto, 12-16 March is confirmed. Reply to this email if you need to change your dates.

scenarios.name: No system prompt
scenarios.first: What's a good way to apologise to a customer when we got their order wrong?
scenarios.read: Thanks for sorting that out so quickly, all good now!
